raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 12
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a mistake when concluding that "Ami Neta Hobo came out first" based on the release dates provided. The release date for "Hood of the Living Dead" was August 30, 2005, which is earlier than the release date for "Ami Neta Hobo" on February 16, 2018. The Planner incorrectly interpreted the dates and concluded that "Ami Neta Hobo" was released first, despite the earlier date for "Hood of the Living Dead" being clearly stated.
